method: WebSearch: whiteface.com season passes, lift tickets, frequent skier card; lakeplacidlegacysites.com/uci

changes.season: 2026–27 alpine season projected November 21, 2026 – April 18, 2027 (ORDA estimate; snow permitting). Cloudsplitter Gondola fall rides Fri–Mon through October 12, 2026.
changes.cost: Adult day ticket up to $134 at peak (seniors $104, juniors 7–12 $89, ages 0–6 $15); Frequent Skier Card $59 brings midweek tickets to $67 and weekends to $101. Buy online ahead for the lowest price.
changes.knowBefore: October 2–4, 2026: Whiteface hosts the UCI Downhill World Cup (17,400 spectators across the two venues last year); expect heavy traffic on NY-86 and full lots that weekend. Lift tickets are cheapest bought online before arrival; walk-up peak pricing is the highest.

note: Opening date is ORDA's projection. 2026–27 adult SKI3 season pass $1,119 until Dec 2, $1,259 after.

changes.season: Most of the West Branch: open season April 1 – October 15 (daily limit 5 trout, only 2 over 12 in); October 16 – March 31 catch-and-release only. Special section from the Whiteface Ski Center bridge downstream to the NY-86 bridge at the Flume: open all year, catch-and-release, artificial lures only.
changes.knowBefore: From October 16 the whole river is catch-and-release with artificial lures. Everyone 16+ needs a New York fishing licence (one-day and seven-day options online). Check the Ausable River Association flow and temperature page before wading.

note: Regulations as summarised by the Ausable River Association; the DEC regulations guide is the legal source and should be linked on the entry's next pass.

changes.season: Open seasonally, 2026 closing day October 12 (daily shuttle June 26 – October 12). Closed for the winter after that.
changes.knowBefore: Last day of the 2026 season is October 12; peak foliage usually overlaps the final two weekends, so go midweek or early. The drive estimate is to the highway entrance, not the summit. The summit stair route is uneven and strenuous for some guests; confirm elevator operation for mobility needs. Seasonal and weather closures apply; the 2026 planned closing date is October 12, subject to conditions.

note: Closure date confirmed on whiteface.com. Not in the due list but a time-sensitive closure guests must know about.

changes.season: Fall 2026: Friday–Monday October 2 – October 12; closing day October 12, 2026. Reopens for skiing in late November.
changes.knowBefore: Fall foliage rides run Friday to Monday only, through October 12, 2026; October 2–4 is the UCI Downhill World Cup weekend at the mountain, so check whether sightseeing rides run those days. The gondola goes to Little Whiteface, not Whiteface Mountain's actual summit. Check operating days, weather, wind restrictions and current accessibility before setting out.
